summary: The Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen has named Stephanie Rosenthal as its new artistic director, starting in early 2027. Rosenthal is currently the director of the (yet to be opened) Guggenheim Abu Dhabi. Throughout her career, Rosenthal has held leadership positions at institutions in Abu Dhabi, London, Berlin, Sydney, and Munich.

headline: Artists Rights Society Launches Partnership with Samsung to License Artworks on Digital Displays
summary: The New York–based Artists Rights Society (ARS), which represents more than 120,000 artists for licensing images of their works in the United States, has announced a partnership with Samsung Art Store to display the work of ARS-represented artists on Samsung TVs.
